name: Harness Toolbox (CHECKPOINT.md)
description: A CLAUDE.md file for stable rules and a CHECKPOINT.md file for where the work stands, kept current by a /checkpoint skill, plus hooks that make each session read the checkpoint before it changes anything.
source_note: From its own documentation; nothing installed or tested for this chart.

installs_as.value: Plugin (skills and hooks), or files copied by hand

offline_no_account.value: Yes: files and local scripts; the agent still needs its own login

plain_files.value: Yes: CLAUDE.md and CHECKPOINT.md, plain Markdown

footprint.value: Tiny: Markdown files plus PowerShell scripts

claude_code.value: Yes, built for it: hooks make each session read the checkpoint

codex.value: Partial: Windows hooks only; skills install for Claude Code

claude_desktop.value: Partial: only Desktop's Code tab, which is Claude Code

os.value: Windows tested; macOS and Linux versions untested

survives_crash.value: Yes: saved file stays; /necromancy recovers unsaved work

survives_compaction.value: Yes: a hook asks for a checkpoint update before compaction

undo_delete.value: Whatever your editor or git gives you

outdated_memory.value: No: old lines are rewritten in place

uninstall.value: No uninstall steps found on pages read
